body:
Invalid source-reference enum values currently reach database constraints, producing IntegrityError and leaving callers needing a rollback. Validate source type, visibility, role, and changed drift status before hashing, ORM assignments, or audit writes, raising ValueError that names the allowed values.

Closes #669

Existing update semantics remain: None means no change. Tests cover every supported enum, precomputed and computed hashes, and mixed updates that must leave both the reference and audit history unchanged when validation fails.

## Validation
- [x] `PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m pytest tests/sources/test_source_references.py --no-cov -q`: 52 passed.
- [x] `PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m pytest tests/sources tests/api/test_source_references.py --no-cov -q`: 73 passed.
- [x] Focused mypy, Ruff, Black, and git diff checks pass.
- [x] Deliberately disabling the enum rejection makes 14 targeted tests fail; restoring validation passes all 73 adjacent tests.

CI and elapsed post-push review are pending. Evidence transcripts are recorded in the opener run 20260919T190036Z.

<!-- pr-preamble:start -->
<!-- meta:issue:669 -->
> **Source:** Issue #669

Closes #669

<!-- pr-preamble:end -->

<!-- auto-status-summary:start -->
## Automated Status Summary
#### Scope
In `create_source_reference` (`src/lms/sources/repository.py:79-121`) and `update_source_reference` (`src/lms/sources/repository.py:148-182`), input arguments for `source_type`, `source_visibility`, `multi_source_role`, and `drift_status` are assigned to `SourceReference` without Python validation against the domain enums `SOURCE_TYPES`, `SOURCE_VISIBILITIES`, `MULTI_SOURCE_ROLES`, and `DRIFT_STATUSES`. Supplying an invalid enum causes `session.flush()` to raise an unhandled `IntegrityError` from SQLite/Postgres CHECK constraints (`source_type_valid`, `source_visibility_valid`, `drift_status_valid`, `multi_source_role_valid` in `src/lms/sources/models.py:38-55`) instead of raising `ValueError`.

#### Tasks
1. [x] In `src/lms/sources/repository.py`, import `SOURCE_TYPES`, `SOURCE_VISIBILITIES`, `DRIFT_STATUSES`, and `MULTI_SOURCE_ROLES` from `lms.sources.models`.
2. [ ] In `create_source_reference`, validate `source_type in SOURCE_TYPES`, `source_visibility in SOURCE_VISIBILITIES`, and `multi_source_role is None or multi_source_role in MULTI_SOURCE_ROLES` (raising `ValueError` with informative messages).
3. [ ] In `update_source_reference`, validate any modified fields in `changes` (`source_type`, `source_visibility`, `drift_status`, `multi_source_role`) against their respective domain tuples before assigning them to the ORM instance and flushing.
4. [x] In `tests/sources/test_source_references.py`, add unit test cases verifying `create_source_reference` and `update_source_reference` raise `ValueError` on invalid enum arguments.

#### Acceptance criteria
- [x] Running `pytest tests/sources/test_source_references.py` passes cleanly.
- [x] Calling `create_source_reference(session, source_type="invalid", ...)` raises `ValueError` with allowed `SOURCE_TYPES`.
- [x] Calling `create_source_reference(session, ..., source_visibility="hidden")` raises `ValueError` with allowed `SOURCE_VISIBILITIES`.
- [x] Calling `update_source_reference(session, reference, ..., drift_status="unknown")` raises `ValueError` with allowed `DRIFT_STATUSES`.
- [x] Deliberately breaking the validation logic causes the targeted tests to fail.

<!-- auto-status-summary:end -->

<!-- This is an auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->
## Summary by CodeRabbit

- **Bug Fixes**
  - Source references now validate types, visibility settings, drift statuses, and multi-source roles.
  - Invalid values are rejected before records are created or updated.
  - Mixed updates containing invalid values are rejected without partial changes.
  - Valid values remain accepted across all supported options.
  - Omitting an optional multi-source role preserves its existing value.
  - Rejected operations leave source data, audit history, and transaction state unchanged.
<!-- end of auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->
